memories.content: The account manager is preparing for a scheduled retention call with Fenwick & Sloane. They know Fenwick & Sloane has expressed intent to cancel their subscription. The account manager has been trained to offer a pause option as a retention tactic and has authority to propose a pause. They want to persuade the retailer to pause instead of cancel.

Brightline Software provides a software subscription to Fenwick & Sloane. A retention call is scheduled for this week (between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-11). During the call, the account manager can propose a pause option. Fenwick & Sloane's subscription is currently active but they have indicated a desire to cancel.
